services.short: Certified installation for over 12 major roof systems.
services.text: Sea-Breeze Roofing, Inc. is a Certified Installer of over 12 major manufacturers, so the system on your building is installed by a crew approved to install it.

body: Sea-Breeze Roofing, Inc. is a Certified Installer of over 12 major manufacturers, including Johns Manville, Elevate (formerly Firestone), Polyglass, GAF, Versico, CertainTeed, Hyload, U.S. Ply, Berridge, Garland, Peterson, and more.
The work is commercial, industrial and institutional. Our office and yard are at 1927 Ahrens Street in Houston, and we have been roofing here since 1982.

about.title: Houston's reliable choice since 1982
text: Sea-Breeze Roofing, Inc. has been Houston's reliable choice since 1982, working on commercial, industrial and institutional buildings from an office and yard at 1927 Ahrens Street.

SBRI works with many School Districts, Universities, and Commercial & Industrial Property Owners, routinely fixing leaks and other roof related issues and building yearly maintenance plans that keep roof systems performing longer.
We are a Certified Installer of over 12 major manufacturers, and an approved vendor through Choice Partners and TIPS.
